items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: The name 'Little Chick' is mentioned only by the [INTERVIEWER] in a conversational interjection ('Hey, Little Chick, no, I don't hear that one'). The interviewee does not respond to this mention, nor does he mention Little Chick in his own turns.

ctx.x: But I re-recorded it for Mr. Walker because Edward Frank did a lousy job on it. It was lousy. And they never put it out. But it was lousy. We recognized it was a good tune. That's why I re-did it with the thing. But this is an interesting tune. You don't hear that.
Hey, Little Chick, no, I don't hear that one.

This sounds good. You'd be surprised how well this thing sounds. Did you write that? Uh-huh. I wrote both sides of this. Do you know any musicians you used on that track? No, I can't remember because Edward Frank. Was Edward Frank?
